# Zebrash v1.41.0 rendering fixtures

ZPL and expected PNGs copied from the MIT-licensed [Zebrash v1.41.0 testdata](https://github.com/Gobbo89/zebrash/tree/v1.41.0/testdata), commit 1ca9db104e745506241b413ccede8e2dffebff19. Render at 799 × 288 pixels, 8 dpmm.

Each image covers spacing -10, 0 and +6 for FO/FB rotation R or I, with full, underfilled or MaxLines=1 blocks. These are engine raster goldens; the placement formula was checked on Zebra ZD230t firmware V89.21.46Z. Do not add Labelary's extra line-spacing shift.
